methodology.buy_formula: V4/V2 formula unchanged: 40% RS20 + 25% return60 + 20% trend + 10% RVOL + 5% RSI
methodology.rsi90_penalty: penalized twins only: post-score max(0, 0.6*(RSI-90)), capped at 12 points at RSI 110; no change to original formula
methodology.baseline: +15% arm, 6% drawdown from High/Close peak plus technical deterioration
methodology.opportunity120: after 120 sessions: return -5%..+5%, score<55, rel20<0, replacement score >= held+15
methodology.thesis_failure: opportunity120 plus after 120 sessions: return<-5%, score<40, rel20<0, replacement score>=75
methodology.execution: signals at close, trades next open; full proceeds reinvested
methodology.benchmark: historical S&P 100 constituents at initial date, equal-weight, no Stockindicator ranking
